proposed_rules.trigger: A full-width bar at the very top of the page, above the hero, containing top-level menu labels (e.g. 'Solutions Business Need Work O...'), present on every sampled page.
proposed_rules.decision: Map to the global nav/header fragment, not page content; exclude from the page's block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical content and position across every packet analyzed indicates shared site chrome, not authored page content.

proposed_rules.trigger: A bottom-most sibling zone (outside the main content wrapper) with a fixed marketing tagline ('The best no-code platform for...') plus a thin separator row.
proposed_rules.decision: Map to the global footer fragment; exclude from page-specific block inventory.
proposed_rules.rationale: Identical content/position on every sampled page = site-wide footer chrome, not per-page content.

proposed_rules.trigger: A large template/app preview screenshot immediately followed by a button labeled 'Install Free Template App', recurring on every download-template page.
proposed_rules.decision: Combine into ONE 'template-download' block: cell1 = preview image, cell2 = CTA link. Rejected alternatives: (a) separate image block + default-content link, (b) folding the preview into the hero as an extra image.
proposed_rules.rationale: The preview+button pairing is a distinct, identically-labeled reusable component specific to Knack's download pages, not generically covered by minimize-block-cells alone.
